verdict.rationale: GitHub Copilot's cloud agent (Copilot coding agent) is documented to plan, explore, and execute work autonomously in isolated cloud sandboxes, launch from GitHub, run tests/tools, and let users track progress and review/merge completed work from a control plane—covering build, test, and review end-to-end. Demo-specific tooling isn't explicitly documented beyond PR review, and there's no independent hands-on account of a full build-test-demo cycle. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the full cloud agent workflow, explicit demo-generation capability (e.g., live previews) beyond code+PR review.
